statement: Exploratory and post hoc: the result is a candidate at most and changes no registered reading, flag or decision.
what_this_file_is: The complete list of tests of the retrospective calibration analysis, written and committed before any measured value was opened. It was derived from the plan, the definitions, the README of the frozen table and the frozen table itself, none of which holds a measured value. No test is added, dropped or altered after this file is committed; a test that proves impossible stays in the family with p = 1 and the reason.

table_facts_used.note: flag_readout marks the same points as flag_cone; max_overcut_couplers_on_cone_qubit takes two values and is non-zero exactly where flag_coupler is true. Tests that are numerically the same for that reason are still listed and all enter the family.

rules_fixed_before_the_join.r: r = ln(measured / dispatch-time prediction) per point of the frozen table, key (list, point_id).
rules_fixed_before_the_join.measured: The registered measured value of the point: the value the post-run review of its list reports for the point (the value the registered comparison sets against the prediction; pooled over the entries of the point as the loader pools them). It is taken at full precision from the registered analysis of the tidy table of the list at main a8136f0068711c43312918ffe9e8221f8a8bdc22 when that reproduces the figure printed in the review to the printed precision; otherwise the figure printed in the review is used and the point is reported. Nothing is re-estimated by another method. A point with no registered measured value is left out of every test and listed with the reason.
rules_fixed_before_the_join.prediction: The committed dispatch-time prediction row the frozen table names for the point (pred_file, pred_stage, pred_model, pred_value_column, pred_estimator), read from main a8136f0068711c43312918ffe9e8221f8a8bdc22. It is checked against the prediction the post-run review used for the same point. If the review used another row, the table's row is kept for r (nothing is re-chosen), s of that point is not used (the point leaves every test of (c)) and the point is reported.
rules_fixed_before_the_join.r_undefined: A point whose measured value or prediction is not a positive finite number has no r; it is left out of every test and listed with the reason.
rules_fixed_before_the_join.days: Day labels of the table: smoke, day1, day2, nov10. 'Within day' means within a day label.
rules_fixed_before_the_join.left_out_job: Job dao2pqv8gn2s739nabkg feeds one point, (paper1_grid_n100_16384, grid n85 L8 k1 r0 s16384), and no other; leaving the job out is leaving that point out.
rules_fixed_before_the_join.two_sided: Permutation tests count rearrangements whose statistic is at least as large in absolute value as the observed one; tol = 1e-12 * max(1, |observed|) guards ties in floating point.
rules_fixed_before_the_join.monte_carlo: m = 10000 rearrangements; one generator per test, numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(2026111201)); a (m x n) array of uniform numbers is drawn once, and the rearrangement within a block is the stable argsort of the block's numbers. What is rearranged is the flag, the covariate or s against r, the points held in the order of the table; 'without regard to day' is one block. Every Monte Carlo test uses the same seed, so that tests that are numerically the same give the same p. p = (b + 1) / (m + 1).
rules_fixed_before_the_join.exact: Listed beside a Monte Carlo test whenever the number of distinct rearrangements, counted from the table, is at most 1000000. p = (number at least as extreme, the observed one included) / (number of rearrangements). If points left out at the join change the count, the enumeration is over the points actually in the test.
rules_fixed_before_the_join.cannot_be_formed: Group test: no block holds both groups. Rank correlation: fewer than 3 points, or the covariate or r constant, or (within-day permutation) the covariate constant within every day. Slope: no residual degree of freedom, or s constant where the fit needs it to vary. Such a test enters the family with p = 1 and the reason. Tests marked can_be_formed_from_table = false are known to be of this kind from the table alone and are listed once.
rules_fixed_before_the_join.family: Benjamini-Yekutieli at 10 percent over the primary test and every listed reading: N = 137 tests, c(N) = sum of 1/i = 5.500842; with the p values sorted, the tests up to the largest k with p_(k) <= k * 0.10 / (N * c(N)) are rejected. The primary test is also read alone at level 0.05 (rejected when p <= 0.05).
rules_fixed_before_the_join.outcome_words: Plan Section 5. (i) Primary test significant and the difference of the same sign on day 1 and on day 2 separately: a candidate. (ii) Primary test not significant: the day-2 value stands as an unexplained single departure that did not replicate. (iii) Section 5 names no outcome for a primary test that is significant without the same sign on days 1 and 2; from the table, day 1 holds no flagged point, so its sign cannot be formed. That case is reported in those words: not a candidate as Section 5 is written, with the reading 'the sign on the days where it can be formed' given beside it and marked as not fixed in advance. The outcome sentence is given for the primary test as written and, beside it, for each listed reading of the primary test.
rules_fixed_before_the_join.conventions_not_multiplied_into_readings: Unweighted means and least squares; a free intercept in every slope test (no fit through the origin); Student t for the parametric slope tests; no robust or measurement-error-weighted variant; the slope tests rearrange within day only; one-sided versions are not listed. These are stated so that they can be judged; they were fixed here, before any measured value was opened.

known_limits_from_the_table: With the left-out point removed, day 2 holds one flagged point and the table 48 distinct within-day rearrangements for the cone grouping: an exact p cannot be below 1/48 and a Monte Carlo p not below about 0.0209.
A Monte Carlo p cannot be below 1/10001; the smallest Benjamini-Yekutieli threshold of this family is 0.10 / (N * c(N)) = 1.327e-04.

Many listed tests are the same test under another name (flag_readout equals flag_cone; the covariate of (b) is a multiple of flag_coupler; a stratified statistic with one informative day equals that day's own test). They are kept: a larger family is the conservative choice.
